note: Phone release configurations. firmware/tools/phone_pins.py reads this file and the release ZIPs (paths relative to $TURBO_INPUTS) and writes FirmwarePins.h and firmware-pins-<name>.json; --check runs in the gate. Every release is named cN, is built on stock 1.0.6.11 and is built only for the 1.0.21 full host (1021-full). With exactly one release, a build that names none (no TIO_RELEASE, no --release) is that release. C21 is the only release: it flashes TMG12 from the 1.0.21 full host and accepts glasses on 1.0.5.12 (TMG11) or 1.0.6.11.

c21.builds: C21: flashes TMG12 (TMG11 ported to stock 1.0.6.11) from the 1.0.21 full host
